title: Safe Deposit Boxes: how a box is drilled, the drilling fee and retrieving drilled contents
content:
## Scope

This policy covers the forced opening of a box in the Safe Deposit Boxes line for unpaid rent: how the drilling is carried out, the drilling fee, the end of the lease, how long the contents are held, and how the former lessee may retrieve them.

## Policy clause

1. Drilling is done under dual control with a witness. The contents are inventoried and sealed.
2. The drilling fee for the box size is charged as a service fee dated the drilling date, and the lease ends: the rental is closed as of the drilling date.
3. The drilled contents are held for 12 months. During that time the former lessee may retrieve them on paying everything due plus the drilled contents storage fee.
4. After the holding period the contents are reported to the state unclaimed property program, which is outside this policy.

## Values by box size

| Official box size | Drilling fee (forced opening of the box) | Months drilled contents are held | Storage fee to retrieve drilled contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 | 12 | $50.00 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 | 12 | $50.00 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | $175.00 | 12 | $50.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | $225.00 | 12 | $50.00 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | $225.00 | 12 | $50.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | $250.00 | 12 | $50.00 |

## Hypothetical retrieval example

A 10x10 box was drilled; the drilling fee of $225.00 was charged and the lease ended. Four months later the former lessee asks to retrieve the contents, and the amount still owed on the rental, drilling fee included, is a hypothetical $400.00. The contents are still within the 12-month holding period. To retrieve them, the former lessee pays everything due, $400.00, plus the storage fee of $50.00: a total of $450.00.

## Sequence in brief

Drilling under dual control with a witness → contents inventoried and sealed → drilling fee charged → lease ends → contents held 12 months, retrievable by the former lessee on paying everything due plus the storage fee → after that, reported to the state unclaimed property program.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the drilling fee the same for every size?** No. It is $175.00 for the 3x5, 3x10 and 5x10 sizes, $225.00 for the 10x10 and 10x15 sizes, and $250.00 for the 10x20 size.

**Does the lease continue after drilling?** No. The lease ends and the rental is closed as of the drilling date.

**Is paying the storage fee alone enough to get the contents back?** No. The former lessee pays everything due plus the storage fee.
